questions.text: What is the one job it must never fail at?
examples: Hold the part steady while drilling
questions.assume: Its main job as written in the overview.

followup.text: What happens if it fails: annoying, costly or dangerous?
followup.assume: A failure is costly, not dangerous.

questions.text: Which loads, motions or forces act on it?
questions.assume: Static load from the overview, safety factor 2.

followup.text: Is there a worst case, like a drop or a sudden shock?

questions.text: What does it attach to or hold?
examples: Two M6 screws into a wall
questions.assume: Standard metric screws into the mounting surface.

extra.text: Does it need to be adjustable after assembly?

questions.text: How will it be made, and by whom?
questions.assume: 3D printed in PETG for the first prototypes.

followup.text: Do you own the machine, or will you order the parts?

questions.text: How many pieces, and by when?
questions.assume: One prototype first, a small batch later.

examples: A press fit for a bearing

questions.text: What is around it that it must fit or clear?
examples: Must fit in a 100 mm gap
questions.assume: Free space around it as in the overview.

questions.text: Which bought-in parts or standards are fixed?
questions.assume: ISO metric fasteners and common bought-in parts.

questions.text: How is it assembled and serviced?
questions.assume: One person with standard hand tools.

extra.text: Do cables or hoses need to pass through or along it?

questions.text: Who will see it, and where?
questions.assume: Mostly hidden; looks are low priority.

questions.text: Which look and finish do you want?
Where will it be used: indoors, outdoors, wet, hot?

followup.text: Any temperatures beyond normal room conditions?

questions.text: Which materials are preferred or ruled out?
questions.assume: Single-material where possible, easy to recycle.

questions.text: What happens to it at end of life?
questions.assume: Screwed, not glued, so it can be taken apart.

extra.text: How will it be cleaned or maintained?
